[[Minea the Obscene]] is a [[mesmer]] [[boss]] hired by [[White Mantle]] for their [[War in Kryta|war]] against the [[Shining Blade]], and is a member of the [[Peacekeeper]]s.

==Locations==
*[[War in Kryta]]
**{{NPC location|Watchtower Coast (War in Kryta)}}

==Skills==
15 [[Domination Magic]] (20 Domination Magic in [[Hard mode]])
*{{skill icon|Rip Enchantment}}
*{{skill icon|Backfire}}
*{{skill icon|Cry of Frustration}}
*{{skill icon|Empathy}}
*{{skill icon|Energy Surge}} ([[elite]])
*{{skill icon|Mistrust}}
*{{skill icon|Overload}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Confessor's Orders]]

==Notes==
*Minea the Obscene will spawn in the alternate location if the character has not observed the first two scenes at [[Shining Blade camp]].
*The group nearest to Minea, which also has additional healers, will often re-join some fights as if they have shared [[aggro]].
